industry: Financial Services - Asset Management, Wealth Management & Retirement Technology
role_summary: Senior technology strategy and architecture leadership role for GWAM Asia, acting as Chief Architect responsible for regional architecture governance via the Local Architecture Review Board (LARB), driving practical AI adoption, building shared technology service capabilities across markets, and optionally overseeing Asia operations technology. Requires strong stakeholder influence across global, regional, and market technology and business leaders.
must_have_requirements: University degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or equivalent practical experience
Strong enterprise, solution, and application architecture experience spanning data, integration, cloud, and security domains
Experience leading architecture governance forums (e.g., architecture review boards) and making risk/cost/scalability trade-off decisions
Demonstrated practical application of AI in business/technology contexts (AI application delivery, agent deployment, or AI-enabled workflow transformation)
Strong knowledge of SDLC in the AI era including AI-assisted engineering, model/agent lifecycle, responsible AI controls, testing, monitoring, and production readiness
Experience designing/promoting shared technology services, reusable platforms, and engineering standards across multiple markets or business lines
Proven senior stakeholder management and influencing skills across business, technology, risk, and market leadership without relying solely on formal authority
Experience aligning regional technology strategy with global enterprise architecture direction and local market priorities
Experience in financial services technology, ideally asset management, wealth, retirement, or operations technology
nice_to_have_requirements: Prior experience overseeing operations technology capabilities (production support, resilience, business continuity)
Experience working across Asia markets or multi-country technology operating models
Familiarity with cloud-native architecture patterns and modern engineering practices (microservices, CI/CD, DevOps)
Experience coaching or developing architects/technology leaders
Exposure to regulatory expectations in wealth/asset management technology environments
Experience with data governance and AI-ready data architecture
soft_skills_priority: Stakeholder influence and senior leadership engagement without formal authority
Strategic thinking connecting global, regional, and local priorities
Facilitation and governance leadership (running review boards, driving consensus)
Communication and storytelling to translate technical concepts for business audiences
Conflict resolution and negotiation across competing market/business priorities

scoring_criteria.name: Enterprise/Solution Architecture Leadership
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Core requirement - the role is explicitly Chief Architect, requiring broad architecture expertise across applications, data, cloud, integration.
evidence_type_to_look_for: Chief Architect or Enterprise Architect titles
scoring_criteria.gap_expected: May lack formal 'Chief Architect' title; assess equivalent scope of ownership

scoring_criteria.name: Architecture Governance & Review Board Leadership
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: LARB leadership is a named responsibility requiring formal governance experience and decision-making authority.
evidence_type_to_look_for: running or chairing architecture review boards

scoring_criteria.name: Practical AI Adoption & Responsible AI Governance
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: JD heavily emphasizes AI strategy, agent-based solutions, and responsible AI controls as a differentiator for this role.
scoring_criteria.gap_expected: Candidates may have AI exposure but limited hands-on agent deployment or governance experience

scoring_criteria.name: AI-Era SDLC Knowledge
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Explicit requirement for understanding AI-assisted engineering, model/agent lifecycle, testing, and production readiness.

scoring_criteria.name: Shared Technology Services & Reusable Platforms
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Role explicitly drives shared capabilities across Asia markets to reduce duplication and improve consistency.

scoring_criteria.name: Senior Stakeholder Influence & Executive Communication
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Role requires influencing senior stakeholders without formal authority across global, regional, market, and business lines.
